title: CapabilityVectorStepDirection
description: DD-124(3)(4): FORWARD steps are driven by the production Core probe execute. RECEIVER marks a step that depends on the service read edge (an ingest consuming a source through READ_EDGE, a NATIVE_MANAGED receiver key); it runs in the isolated deployment of 07 §8A and the production plan only observes it through receiver_start/receiver_observe. A case with a RECEIVER step is a receiver-direction case.
